args.prompt: Photorealistic cinematic still life, single landscape 16:9 frame. Close oblique overhead view of a plain paper hand-drawn neighborhood map on a simple indoor basement communications desk. The map has two simple pictograms, a large warehouse-style grocery store and a small gasoline station a few kilometers away, joined by a road line. No precise coordinates, no readable long text, no other detailed infrastructure. A pencil, small notebook and ordinary radio transceiver next to map. Windowless dry clean concrete room, soft practical desk lamp, modest realistic detail. No people, no subtitles, titles, watermark or collage. Just a mundane civilian map and radio used to arrange a grocery delivery.
